name: AI Tools SME

sources.title: Submit Your Tool — six paid packages (A-F) from 50€ to 900€, PayPal checkout

requirements: Paid only — cheapest entry is Package-A 'AI Tool List Placement' at 50€ (dofollow link card under filters)
Higher tiers: Comparison Feature 250€, Premium Comparison (image/video/presentation categories) 500€, Detailed Review 500€, bundles 700€/900€
Form requires Name, Email, Tool Name, full business address (street, post code, city, country), Website, AI Tool Category
Payment via PayPal; review happens after payment ('Once your payment is confirmed, we'll review your submission')
preparation: Full business address (required — not just email)
PayPal-compatible payment method and budget (50€ minimum)
workflow: Pick a package (A listing / B-C comparison / D review / E-F bundles)
Fill the form fields including business address
Submit → redirected to PayPal payment page
After payment confirmation, they review and contact you if more info is needed
watchFor: No free tier at all — every package goes through PayPal checkout
Review is post-payment; rejection/refund policy not stated on the form
Business address is required — GDPR-style data collection, consent text included
countsAsLive: The tool appears as a card with a dofollow link in the AI Tools List under its category filters
unknowns: Refund/rejection policy if they decline the tool after payment
Listing duration (permanent vs annual) — not stated
Whether Package-A's dofollow link persists without renewal
